title.value: EuclidNets: An Alternative Operation for Efficient Inference of Deep Learning Models
title.justification: The title succinctly captures the main focus of the paper which is the introduction of EuclidNets as a method for efficient inference in deep learning.
title.quote: Title: EuclidNets: An Alternative Operation for Efficient Inference of Deep Learning Models

extractions.description: The paper presents EuclidNets, a compression method for deep learning models, designed to optimize hardware efficiency by replacing multiplication operations with Euclidean distance. This approach maintains model performance while reducing computational costs, particularly in contexts with limited resources such as edge devices.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is the development of an efficient deep learning model architecture rather than addressing specific climate or ecological sustainable development goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: With the advent of deep learning application on edge devices, researchers actively try to optimize their deployments on low-power and restricted memory devices.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on computational efficiency in deep learning models, which does not directly align with climate or ecological sustainable development themes.
primary_category.quote: We propose EuclidNet, a compression method, designed to be implemented on hardware which replaces multiplication, xw, with Euclidean distance (x − w)².
